name: Outline Tear
description: The first clip tears across along its own strongest outline, such as a horizon, showing white paper fibers; the torn top is pulled up and the bottom drops down, casting soft shadows on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rim
params.description: Width of the white torn edge, relative to the frame height

params.name: roughness
params.description: How ragged the tear is around the outline, relative to the frame height

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the paper fibers on the torn edges

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip (alpha: strength)
